title: Figure 1: Simplified rendering of a neuron - cell body, dendrites, axon, terminals
description: Color illustration captioned 'Figure 1. Simplified Rendering of a Neuron. The arrows indicate the direction in which signals are conveyed...' (Reference 1). Labels identify the 'cell body', 'dendrites', 'axon (less than 1 mm to more than 1 m in length)' and 'terminal branches of axon', with magenta arrows showing signal direction. It appears under the heading 'Direct Neural Signals' in a discussion of brain-machine interfaces.
